{{Top|leg}}
[[File:Padmepilot.jpg|thumb|right|100px|Padmé Amidala in a pilot suit]]
A type of '''tactical pilot suit''' was worn by [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] and [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gregar Typho/Legends|Gregar Typho]] shortly before an [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala/Legends|assassination attempt]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], during the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]]. Amidala wore a [[Belt/Legends|belt]] with a [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] emblem to accompany the suit, and Typho utilized his suit as a traditional security tunic.<ref name="AOTC VD">''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>
